RESULT [weeds]: Reports a 6.7% improvement in weeding accuracy and a 32.3% reduction in energy cost against existing weed-recognition-only systems.
US [weeds]: For the laser car, a box is the wrong target: aiming at the stem or growth point saves laser energy. A future labelling domain could add a stem keypoint class, and the cwd12 box mAP goal does not measure what the laser needs.
